notes.title: We are launching HELLO GOODBOY this month!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32007488/c99d04823389f8eb3b2a2283e99715978213d7bf.png[/img]

Hello goodkid!

After creating [b]Rage in Peace[/b] and [b]What Comes After[/b] game, now we are ready to announce that our new game, Hello Goodboy, will be released on May 25th! We’re inviting you to join the excitement and experience the wholesome journey in this game!

[h1]Hello Goodboy![/h1]

[b]Hello Goodboy[/b] is a cozy and wholesome narrative game about finding the purpose of your journey in the afterlife. You will play as Iko and have Coco the cute doggo as your company.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32007488/7990de78a79e6207b1153cdc894d1805f70ebd71.gif[/img]

In this game, you can meet various and unique characters, do nice things to others, enjoy delicious food, and pet the dog! You can do all of that while trying to unveil the mystery of your journey in this place to mend your forgotten past memories and life.

Watch the Hello Goodboy wholesome trailer here:
[previewyoutube=NsyCkqOlk0Y;full][/previewyoutube]

If you enjoy the bittersweet story of Rage in Peace, please check out this new game of ours as well!

Hello Goodboy will be released on May 25th 2023 on Steam and several other platforms. Make sure to wishlist the game so you will not missed the date! :D

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1789090

[b]Have a good day from Hello Goodboy![/b] 🐶❤️

notes.title: Rage In Peace 3rd Anniversary and New Game Announcement!
notes.notes:
Hi everyone! 

Hope everybody is healthy and doing well.

November 8th, 2021 is the 3rd anniversary of Rage In Peace! Yeay! Thank you for your support to Timmy, Rolling Glory Jam, and Toge Productions for all of this time. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32007488/0d3d696eba7e22b29eecc2f5e6dbf7dcaf6d847c.jpg[/img]

We are very happy to see how much love and support we've been getting these past 3 years. We see people are still playing and streaming our games, we received cute memes and wonderful fan arts... Timmy is truly happy!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32007488/6696f49b59371476e71508239f1267b92b95a806.png[/img]
Fan art by Epic Epic and Wolfie from [url=https://discord.gg/toge]Discord[/url]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32007488/263987056c95362fdbee2733b9b754285db110ff.jpg[/img]

We are happy to see how much you all have been enjoying Rage in Peace and we hope the game can still entertain a lot of people for a long time.

[h3]New game from Rolling Glory Jam![/h3]

We will also want to use this opportunity to announce that Rolling Glory Jam is working on a game called Hello Goodboy, it's a wholesome narrative adventure game about the afterlife, where you journey with a dog, do nice things to others, and enjoy comfort food. 

Hello Goodboy is in alpha development phase, show your support by wishlisting the game here:

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1789090/Hello_Goodboy/

Embark on a wholesome journey with Iiko and Coco through the afterlife and help other souls along the way. Uncover the mystery of the journey and prepare for whatever awaits.

It's a smile-inducing yet deep story-driven game like Rage In Peace - without the rage game element. You if you like RIP's story, you might like Hello Goodboy too (hopefully!). Wish us luck with the development.

Thanks and warm regards from Bandung.

notes.title: Rage in Peace Trading Cards Now Available
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32007488/b79053a36f6fc5b3328600f02345ccda70983771.png[/img]

Hello, Pilgrims! 

It's been a while, we hope you all doing fine with the ups and downs of life. Surely, there are some achievements you had done, so you can be proud of yourself.

Speaking of achievements, today we have an exciting announcement for you! Rage in Peace trading cards are available on Steam! You can get up to three random trading cards whenever you rack up your playtime on the game. 

You can obtain Rage in Peace exclusive badges, profile backgrounds, and emoticons. Now you can express yourself with others on Steam with Timmy and friends!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32007488/b1761870710dc15b41e3bc8ab846bff0e68aaaaf.gif[/img]
[b][i]The classic Timmy and his friends in emotcons format! An ouchie is also included! [/i][/b]

You can rank up your Rage in Peace exclusive badges by completing a set of five different cards with the theme surrounding Timmy and other recognizable characters in the game. Not to mention, you can also craft the trading cards, trade them, or find them in the community market. What kind of exclusive badges you can get?

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32007488/028a09ade4fdb3a278d937cf6661a6f7df932118.gif[/img]
[b][i]The simplified themed badges of Timmy's misadventures.[/i][/b]

Looking for new games to play? 
Our friends at Toge Productions together with Mojiken Studio are developing a game called A Space for the Unbound. It's a slice-of-life adventure game with beautiful pixelart that tells a story about overcoming anxiety, depression, and the relationship between a boy and a girl with supernatural powers. 

[b]The demo is currently available[/b] on Steam, feel free to check it out!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1201280/A_Space_For_The_Unbound__Prologue/

You can also[b] wishlist the game right now[/b]. We hope the game to be released next year in 2022. Please stay tuned for further information! 

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1201270/A_Space_For_The_Unbound/


Thank you for all of your support.
Please stay safe and healthy!

notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32007488/5b876e440c41944ae912dd294ffc0b5659982f99.png[/img]

How's life?

It's been a while since we post any updates here. Also, we are terrible sad to see how the world is now, but let's stay strong and keep safe! Not only you need to take care of yourself, but also take care of those people around you who probably need your help. Don't be afraid to ask for help to if you need one!

[h3]LudoNarraCon Sale[/h3]
We are so excited to announce that we are participating in LudoNarraCon Sale this year, thanks to our friends at Felllow Traveller for giving us the opportunity. We'll be giving [b]60% OFF[/b] for Rage in Peace until May 1st, 2020.

Spread the word to your friends and family and everyone who has Rage in Peace on their wishlist!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/658690/Rage_in_Peace/

[h3]Now available in Indonesian[/h3]
And good news to our friend in our beloved country, Indonesia, Rage in Peace is now available in Bahasa Indonesia! [i]Hore! Terima kasih semuanya![/i]

Rage in Peace uses lots of Indonesian culture for story and environment references. We are also working together with local indie band to contribute in filling in the soundtrack from the game. We are glad to finally releases Bahasa Indonesia in the language option and we hope more people will enjoy playing Rage in Peace.

Thank you and please keep supporting us!

Cheers!

notes.title: Discount & Fairy Tale mode - a new way to enjoy the game without the frustration
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32007488/749fe89469c7b390f41b4416df0f258239ad0ef5.gif[/img]

Hello everyone!

To celebrate the anniversary of the poetic rage-inducing platformer, Rage in Peace, we are proud to announce the all-new Fairy Tale mode! The Fairy Tale mode will allow the players to enjoy Rage in Peace's story without the frustration of dying over and over and over again.

With the new update, players will still meet the challenges just like the original experience, while having invincibility to help them go through the almost impossible tasks with ease. Allowing those who only wanted to enjoy Rage in Peace as a beautiful cinematic experience can get the same satisfaction without the frustration. To access the Fairy Tale Mode, players only need to choose the option available before they started the game and enjoy the experience.

The new Fairy Tale mode will be available for PC starting today.

Rage in Peace is also available for 50% off for the week, so grab it while the sale lasts!
http://store.steampowered.com/app/658690/Rage_in_Peace/

notes.title: Rage in Peace Won Game Prime's Game of the Year Award
notes.notes:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32007488/c0874ce521b97e1e59b1df8a237736c418a695f5.jpg[/img]

Earlier this month on Game Prime Awards 2019, Rage in Peace won the "Game of the Year" award. Meaning that the story-driven action adventure game will have the opportunity to be showcased at GameStart 2019—Southeast Asia's Premier Game Convention. "We feel honored that people, especially those from the local gaming industry, appreciate our work," said Dominikus D. Putranto, Rage in Peace's game director & programmer, "we hope that more people could enjoy the game as well as we are showing it at a regional level."

Game Prime Awards is part of Game Prime 2019, an annual event hosted by the Indonesian Agency for Creative Economy (BEKRAF). The event took place in the capital city of Jakarta and featured some of the best games made by local developers; from mobile game, PC game to board game. There were four awards categories presented there, including Best Booth, Citizen Choice, Tabletop Game of the Year, and Game of the Year.

notes.title: Lose Yourself in the Endearing World of She and The Light Bearer
notes.notes:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/5485678/7bef19430d13e3779c75acf2527e9868fc39e10f.jpg[/img]

Do you still remember the feeling of unfolding a story in a fairytale, when you eagerly anticipate what will happen next when you turn the page? Toge Productions, along with developer Mojiken Studio brings you She and the Light Bearer, a game that lets you experience that whimsical feeling with just a click. The game is available NOW on Steam for PC and Mac.

She and The Light Bearer is a blend of point-and-click adventure gameplay and a music album that utilizes hand-drawn art, poetry, dialogue, and an instrumental acoustic soundtrack to offer a relaxing foray into a mystical realm of wonder. The aesthetic came under the influence of the creator herself.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/5485678/7672de1081288845c78febabca50c763b50a7c87.png[/img]

Follow the journey of The Little Firefly who wanders in an unknown forest, carrying a grand task with them. As the world has lost its balance since The Mother fell into a deep slumber, our Little Firefly is entrusted to find The Mother to bring back harmony upon the land. In the unknown forest, The Little Firefly will have to solve various riddles, challenges, and puzzles to prove their worth and earn the forest’s trust. Deeper into the forest, they will learn the sacrifice of the forest, the horror of the Devourer, and the secret to awaken Mother.

Find more details about the [url=http://togeproductions.com/shethegame/]game in its official website here[/url], or through its Steam page below:
http://store.steampowered.com/app/658590/She_and_the_Light_Bearer/

notes.title: Want to enjoy Timmy's story at your own pace? We have the mode for you!
notes.notes:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32007488/59f44400b132508de01b8712d9d1e65c0645e799.gif[/img]
'Sup, folks! How many of you have finished the game? How many of you feel that the game is a bit too hard to play? Mwuhuhu.

I know, I know. That's why the game comes with Goldfish Mode — a mode specially built for you who want to enjoy the emotional story of Timmy's journey but find it too difficult or annoying to conquer!

With this mode, you'll meet checkpoints more frequently. Sooo say goodbye to memorizing too many of those skateboarding moai head, wreck balls, shark puddles, well you name it! We've made sure you can still experience Timmy's journey to achieve his dream without having you break your controller.

To activate Goldfish Mode, you can click on an empty slot and turn the Goldfish Mode on before you start the game.

And what if you already went halfway of the playthrough and wanted to use the Goldfish Mode? WORRY NOT! Just go back to the map, press the start menu, and turn the Goldfish Mode on!

Now, sit back and enjoy the story!

notes.title: The Day Timmy Dies
notes.notes:
8 November is today!

We are so thrilled! Finally, the game we have been working for 2.5 years is released! Ah, we can't express what we are feeling right now, maybe we will take a little time to scream at the corner of the room to let it burst later.

We just hope you all enjoy it and have fun with Timmy on his last day.

After playing the game, you can continue the journey by listening to the Original Soundtrack via Steam, Spotify, iTunes Music, Deezer, or Google Music. There will be all of BGMs along the music if you buy the OST DLC on Steam.

Ah, and join Toge Productions' discord http://discord.gg/toge if there any feedback or just to say hi and get in touch with us.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32007488/83ee6bb179a595ccacc635eb1e0baccb09f989f7.png[/img]

Thank you to Monkey Melody, for the company of dreaming together and ultimately achieve it. Thank you to Toge Productions, our lovely publisher, and of course Nanaba Records for making those which were impossible to be possible!

Thank you to you all! Have fun!

notes.title: Rage in Peace Launches November 8
notes.notes:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32007488/209247832cb42f075c22d02a2240e16b1550893a.png[/img]

FINALLY!!! We are so happy to announce that [b]Rage In Peace[/b] will be out NEXT WEEK on Steam for PC and Mac. BUT WAIT! There's more! It is also coming to Nintendo eShop for Nintendo Switch. Woohoo!

Mark your calendar! [b]8 November 2018[/b]
You will be the one to decide how Timmy will die.

Thank you for your support! We won't be here without you all! We are so excited for the game to be released and bet you all are too! All we hope is that you will enjoy this game. Feel free to join the discussion at [b]Toge Productions[/b] Discord server [url=discord.gg/toge]here[/url]. We'll be there to hear your feedback or even just for a random talk, as well as other Rage in Peace players from all around the globe. 

Spread the word and be part of the special day!
